title: Design Studio Selections Change Order Fee Card Note: Successive Paid Change Orders
content:
The paid-order multiple of a fee-bearing change order on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the fee-bearing buyer-requested change orders already recorded on the file, that is the buyer-requested change orders recorded beyond the package's free change orders:

| Fee-bearing buyer-requested change orders already recorded | Paid-order multiple |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2 |
| Exactly one | 1.5 |
| None | 1 |

The count is the buyer-requested change order entries already on the design ledger less the package's free change orders, never below zero.

**The ladder read against each package's free change orders**

| Package | Free change orders | Buyer-requested already recorded giving 1 | giving 1.5 | giving 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 or more |
| Studio Classic | 1 | 1 or fewer | 2 | 3 or more |
| Studio Select | 1 | 1 or fewer | 2 | 3 or more |
| Studio Designer | 2 | 2 or fewer | 3 | 4 or more |
| Studio Signature | 2 | 2 or fewer | 3 | 4 or more |
| Studio Atelier | 3 | 3 or fewer | 4 | 5 or more |

*Hypothetical case:* on a Studio Designer file with four buyer-requested change orders already recorded, two of them are beyond the two free change orders, so the multiple is 2.
